task:
FIX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #834 (v3-host-cleanup), round 1. Work on the existing branch (target_branch). Keep the workflow-level concurrency group `chatgpt-ed-new-ops` exactly as it is now (Claude restored it deliberately; do NOT move the workflow into v3-production-application-authority and do NOT add a job-level group). Address exactly these, each with tests:

1. Hostless Docker mounts: protected_docker_paths() rejects any container mount with an empty Source, so a stopped governed worker with `--tmpfs /tmp` (Docker reports {"Type":"tmpfs","Source":""}) makes the whole operation a no-op. Handle mount Type explicitly: ignore hostless tmpfs (and npipe) mounts; still require an absolute Source for `bind` and `volume` mounts; any other/unknown type with no absolute source -> refuse (fail closed).
2. Docker protection race: cleanup_path() revalidates after the slow du with the protected-path tuple captured BEFORE the first validation. Re-run protected_docker_paths() immediately before the second validation (just before rm) and use that fresh tuple.
3. Bind-mount sources: mount_points() keeps only the mountinfo mount-point field. Also parse the mount ROOT field (field 4, octal-unescaped). For every mountinfo entry on the same major:minor device as the `/` entry, other than `/` itself, treat its root as a bind source path and refuse a candidate if within(root, candidate) or within(candidate, root) (i.e. the candidate is, contains, or is inside a bind-mounted source exposed elsewhere). Keep the existing mount-point checks.
4. Host lock: GitHub's concurrency fence is released if the runner/ssh dies while the remote action continues. Make the action itself hold the derived purge's host lease for its whole duration: open /run/lock/edfinder-v3-derived-purge.lock (O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, require a regular file) and take fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) BEFORE any validation; if it is held, refuse everything with failure `purge_host_lease_held`; keep it until the receipt is printed. Use the same path constant as scripts/operator/lib/v3_purge_state.py / v3_generation_purge.py (import nothing from the repo on the host; assert in a test that the literal matches those modules). Document in docs/operations/operator-command-contexts.md that clean-up and the purge exclude each other via this lease as well as the workflow group.
5. Bytes freed: rename the per-path du figure to `bytes_removed_estimate` (du -sx estimate before deletion) and replace `total_bytes_freed` with `filesystem_bytes_reclaimed` = root_df_after.available_bytes - root_df_before.available_bytes (may be smaller than the estimate because of hard links / open files). Update the annotation summary and docs wording ('estimated bytes removed', 'filesystem space reclaimed').

Then reply in each review thread on PR #834 is NOT needed (Claude will). Run ruff, actionlint if available, and: pytest tests/test_v3_host_cleanup.py tests/test_v3_derived_purge_ops_workflow.py tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_mutators.py tests/test_v3_production_derived_purge_workflow.py; the authority gate `python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate` must report failures []. Do not dispatch any workflow.
